fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Sarjana Syariah (Pengurusan) (Master of Syariah (Management)) (programme code mg02), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20240706183653): RM17,200 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/mg02, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20240706183653/https://study.uis.edu.my/mg02.

requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor degree with minimum 2nd Class Lower
